verses.text: For the music director. A psalm by David. God, hear my voice as I bring you my complaint. Keep me alive through the terror my enemy brings.
Hide me from the plots of the wicked and from the noisy crowd of evildoers.
They sharpen their tongues like swords and aim deadly words like arrows,
to shoot at innocent people from hiding. They strike without warning and without fear.
They urge each other on in their evil plans. They talk about setting traps in secret and say, “Who will see them?”
They plot injustice and say, “We’ve worked out the perfect plan!” The human mind and heart are deep and crafty.
But God will shoot at them. An arrow will strike them without warning.
Their own tongues will bring them down. Everyone who sees them will shake their head.
People everywhere will stand in awe. They’ll tell of God’s work and think carefully about what he’s done.
The righteous will rejoice in the LORD and take refuge in him. Everyone with an upright heart will praise him!
